name: Plush dog toy
definition: a soft stuffed toy made for a dog, often with a squeaker.

name: Dog rope or tug toy
definition: a rope, ring or woven toy made for a dog to tug or chew.

name: Dog fetch toy
definition: a ball, flyer or stick made to be thrown for a dog to fetch.

name: Dog puzzle or treat-dispensing toy
definition: an interactive toy that a dog works at to release food or solve a puzzle.

name: Dog dental chew
definition: a chew or treat made to clean a dog's teeth.

name: Dog training treat
definition: a small treat made to reward a dog during training.

name: Dog bone, bully stick or rawhide chew
definition: a long-lasting natural or pressed chew for a dog, such as a bone, bully stick or rawhide.

name: Dog jerky treat
definition: a dried strip of meat sold as a treat for dogs.

name: Dog biscuit or cookie
definition: a baked biscuit, cookie or bakery-style treat for dogs.

name: Artificial aquarium plant
definition: a plastic or silk plant that stands in a tank as decoration.

name: Aquarium bogwood
definition: a piece of bog wood, mopani or root placed in a tank.

name: Aquarium rock or pebbles
definition: decorative rock, stone or pebbles placed in a tank, often sold by the kilo.

name: Aquarium ornament
definition: a themed figure, ruin or other decorative object placed in a tank.

name: Aquarium background
definition: a poster or backdrop fixed to the outside of a tank.
